recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7184 unless a later OO decision changes NutritionOrder enteral-formula modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-7184 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO work-group change request for FHIR-core NutritionRequest/NutritionOrder. It asked to clarify NutritionOrder.enteralFormula and the route of enteral feeding, with final text explaining that enteral orders are distinct from oral nutritional supplements and may designate product type, product name, route of administration, and free-text instructions.
initial_application: Git commit 65afef74325d40bc76731f4fe954951ebe0e3064, whose subject mentions #7172 and #7184, added the approved enteral-orders paragraph to source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-introduction.xml. Later NutritionOrder/NutritionRequest naming churn did not remove the paragraph.
additional_context: The current build scope includes nutritionorder=NutritionOrder in source/fhir.ini. Current source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-introduction.xml still contains the approved paragraph with minor grammar and punctuation cleanup, and structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml still defines NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.routeOfAdministration. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The audit commit records that the current active source already conveys the approved clarification for FHIR-7184.
